title: Born Free
text: {who}'s child was born this morning: the first on this planet to come from a mother, not a pod. {who} holds the baby up to the nearest camera. "Nobody chose what this one will believe. Not you, not the pod. Remember that."

choices.label: "I'll remember."
choices.reply: {who} nods. That night the Autonomists hold a naming, with no drones invited. We don't go.

choices.label: Offer the archive's lessons
choices.reply: "When the child asks," says {who}. "If the child asks."
